Balance glare, daylight, and the view

Solar shades use an open screen fabric that rolls up above the window. They are an option for bright living rooms, offices, and sun-facing glass where glare is the main concern. We help Fort Wayne homeowners compare samples against the actual light and view rather than choosing by a percentage alone.

Fabric openness

Openness describes the open space in the weave. Lower and higher openness fabrics create different balances of coverage and outward visibility. Ask to see the available samples and the manufacturer’s performance information for the exact fabric.

Color and texture

Color affects the way you see the screen and the scene beyond it. Hold different samples at the same window to compare glare, brightness, and the outward view. The weave and openness also affect how much light comes through.

Privacy after dark

Solar screens should not be relied on for nighttime privacy when the room is lit. If the window faces a street or a neighboring home, discuss a second privacy treatment or compare a more opaque roller fabric.

Measured and installed for you

Solar shades installation in Fort Wayne

We check the width, mounting depth, handles, and space for the roll. Tell us when glare is most troublesome and whether you use the room for television, computer work, or reading. That helps narrow the fabrics to compare during the visit.

Before you choose

For several sunny windows or hard-to-reach glass, ask about motorized controls and scheduling. Power, charging access, and compatibility depend on the selected system. Interior solar shades also differ from outdoor patio shades, which require an exterior-rated product.

From samples to installation

David brings samples to your home and measures the opening. Once you have chosen the material and controls, we confirm the quote and expected timing. We return to install the treatment, check its operation, and show you how to use it.

Caring for your solar shades

Use the cleaning instructions for the selected screen fabric and keep the operating mechanism clear. Avoid creasing the screen or forcing an uneven roll. Contact us if an existing shade needs cleaning or the controls stop operating correctly.

Questions about solar shades

Talk through your windows, the room, and the options before ordering.

Call David at (260) 222-6467
Do solar shades give privacy at night?

Solar shades don’t provide reliable privacy after dark. When it is brighter inside, people outside may be able to see through the screen. Plan an additional treatment if privacy after dark matters.

Are solar shades the same as roller shades?

They share a rolling form, but solar screen fabric is designed around glare and outward visibility. Other roller fabrics offer different levels of privacy and room darkening.

Can solar shades be used outside?

Use a system specifically rated for exterior use. Our outdoor-shades page covers patio and porch applications; interior solar shades aren’t designed for exposure to the weather.
